observed.limit: The original runtime leaf error was erased; no individual call is proven to have reached the unconditional Rust refusal rather than an earlier failure.

chain.behavior: With enforceSizeCap and serialized payload >24,000 characters, writes AES-256-GCM ciphertext+tag under hol-guard-hook-payload-* temporary directory (requested0700), file0600; outer guard_payload_ref binds version/path/SHA256/key/nonce/json/encryption/serialized_chars. Outer event/tool metadata remains. Cleanup is retained until callback completion.

Validates reference metadata/path and reserves MAX_HOOK_PAYLOAD_REFERENCE_BYTES=5MiB via hook_payload_reference_size; does not decrypt/hydrate. Keeps existing absolute deadline and scheduler admission.
Auto/force raw native route forwards outer payload to the Rust envelope. No production hydration before that call; failure goes to availability rather than Python semantic evaluation.

Validates envelope/event/source and establishes original deadline and v3 request commitment. payload_kind classifies any object guard_payload_ref as EncryptedPayloadRef before source-ref classification. evaluate_validated_envelope unconditionally returns native_hook_encrypted_payload_unsupported for that kind.

Explicit compatibility/normalized CLI loader reads/decrypts local reference with bounded hash validation. Ordinary native raw route returns before compatibility loader. Ownership contract's hook_request_projection entry labels semantic hydration unreachable in ordinary production semantics.

Can validate inner guard_source_ref and full source text, keep intrinsic block stronger than policy, and emit reviewed_output_sha256; currently never receives the decrypted inner payload from the encrypted edge.

smallest_reviewable_product_design.location: Rust PostToolUse envelope evaluation, not Python hydration
requirements: Keep encrypted PreToolUse unsupported unless a separate original accepted requirement justifies it; current actual Pi source cases are PostToolUse.
Admit a finite exact reference schema/encoding/version/AEAD key+nonce shape and the existing maximum ciphertext/plaintext sizes before allocation.

Retain trusted temporary-root/private-directory and file ownership/path rules, descriptor-bound no-follow/nonblocking regular-file reading, hash/identity checks, and terminal refusal on ambiguity. The existing generic secure-fs read is not by itself an owner-private encrypted-payload reader and lacks O_NONBLOCK at open; do not blindly reuse it.

Use already-locked ring AES_256_GCM with the original tag/no-AAD producer contract; only successful authentication yields inner JSON. Verify bounded inner object/event agreement, reject nested encrypted-reference recursion, and retain inner source/tool/correlation inputs.
Preserve the captured absolute deadline across file read, decryption, JSON bounds, inner source scan/policy join and receipt. Do not reset it after preparation.

Retain original outer request commitment and encrypted_payload_ref receipt kind; outer digest/hash/key/nonce commits the authenticated plaintext without silently changing v3 identity. Evaluate source/policy against actual decoded inner payload and retain outer attribution separately.
Continue exact native receipt validation and source output proof; never accept an availability allow as scanned output or relabel missing receipts.
